name: Replenishing minefield generator
summary: Allows a structure or scripted proxy to maintain a deterministic pattern of anti-personnel or anti-vehicle mines without duplicate stacking.

sources.notes: Primary implementation; adapted to validate placement before creation and replenish only empty slots.
Secondary reference for the Generals-style use case.

dependencies: mine actor definitions such as MINV and MINP

integration.migration_notes: Inherit ^ReusableMinefieldGenerator, then override Mines, Locations, timing, and RequiresCondition for faction balance. The abstract component does not change existing units until a concrete actor opts in.

evidence: Isolated Debug build of OpenRA.Mods.Cnc/OpenRA.Mods.Common completed with 0 errors.
OpenRA.Utility ra --check-yaml passed after loading the abstract RA component and validating all bundled RA maps, sequences, and Fluent references.
